feature_findings.alarm: Alarm-only produced 0 emitted sound traces in both herbivore-only fixtures; in mixed_refuge, per-seed emissions are 4325, 2635, and 3916. All receptions remain Unknown because none of the 45 runs captured Perception-bearing decision traces.
feature_findings.ambush_perception_scope: The per-feature arm is valid for the current feature flag. In src/systems/perception.rs, the cover/stamina concealment condition has no predator-prey/species predicate and can hide same-species entities in Food/Burrow cover, changing mate visibility in herbivore-only fixtures even with zero attacks. Keep its outcomes separate from predation benefit.
feature_findings.climate: The fixed period-80 climate arm reports 140 winter ticks per 600-tick World. It was crossed with all three habitat fixtures; sparse_resource remains the existing sparse-resource fixture rather than being relabeled seasonal.
feature_findings.extra_traits: The arm expresses and inherits the joint vision/stamina genome package. Event-reported paid sums are recorded in the per-seed metrics; totals outside event coverage remain Unknown.

interpretation_limits.alarm_receptions: Unknown/null for all 45 runs because every run recorded zero Perception-bearing decision traces; this is not zero reception.
interpretation_limits.ambush_mechanism: In src/systems/perception.rs, ambush concealment filters any fully rested living entity in cover without a predator/prey or species condition. Food cells and their neighbors count as cover. Therefore the ambush-only flag changes conspecific visibility/mate perception even in herbivore-only fixtures with zero attacks; results there are not evidence of predation protection. This is a measured consequence of the current implementation, not a post-run correction.
interpretation_limits.environmental_stress: Lower abundance is reported with births/deaths, survival exposure, reproduction, body stress, and resource stocks; it is not intrinsically labeled worse.
interpretation_limits.extra_trait_actual_paid_total: Only EntityMetabolized event-reported requested/paid sums are reported; actual totals outside event coverage remain Unknown.
interpretation_limits.founder_and_f1_endpoint: All founders and all F1 breeders were dead by tick 600 in these runs; living descendant-breeder count is separately reported.
interpretation_limits.mixed_habitat: Carnivore population ended at zero in every arm and seed; mixed coexistence was not sustained to tick 600. Alarm-only seed 62323 ended with both species extinct.

meaning.alarm_receptions: null/Unknown unless every captured decision trace has Perception
meaning.f1_breeder_count: unique generation-1 individuals that appear as a parent in a mating/birth event
meaning.living_descendant_breeder_count: nonfounder parent IDs from mating/birth events alive at tick 600
meaning.living_entity_ticks: sum of living individuals at the end of each simulated tick
meaning.living_f1_breeder_count: those F1 breeders still living at tick 600
meaning.low_health_alive_tick_sum: sum over 600 ticks of living bodies at or below one quarter maximum health
meaning.zero_energy_alive_tick_sum: sum over 600 ticks of living bodies with energy zero
